CMST 510.title: Advanced Theory, Film and Media
CMST 510.description: Current trends and topics in scholarship, based on an intensive look at a few key theorists and theories.

CMST 520.title: Advanced Cinema and Media Criticism
CMST 520.description: Film and media criticism, with detailed interrogation of conceptual foundations and contemporary case-studies.

CMST 531.title: Seminar: Styles in Film
CMST 531.description: Studies in styles or film genres such as narrative, documentary, ethnographic, experimental, etc. Topics will vary from year to year. A maximum of 6 credits will be granted for FIST_V 531 or CMST_V 531.

CMST 532.title: Seminar: Study of Major Film Artists
CMST 532.description: Investigations into the biographical, social, and national backgrounds of two or three major artists, with attention to the specific nature of their work in its historical, psychological, and cultural contexts. Topics will vary from year to year. A maximum of 6 credits will be granted for FIST_V 532 or CMST_V 532.

CMST 534.title: Seminar in Cinema Studies
CMST 534.description: Topics to be arranged. A maximum of 6 credits will be granted for FIST_V 534 or CMST_V 534.

CMST 547.title: Directed Studies in Cinema and Media
CMST 547.description: A maximum of 6 credits will be granted for FIST_V 547 or CMST_V 547.

CMST 549.title: Thesis
CMST 549.description: A maximum of 18 credits will be granted for FIST_V 549 or CMST_V 549.
